gloss: A eukaryotic cell formed from the fusion of two gametes (“reproductive cells”) during a fertilization process.
Of, relating to, or located in the area of the zygomatic bone or zygomatic arch.
A form of Louisiana Creole music, characteristically performed by accordion and washboard bands, that combines Cajun and Creole roots music with elements of African-American music.
Any of a group of enzymes that catalyze the fermentation of simple carbohydrates to ethanol and carbon dioxide.
Of, pertaining to or existing as a zygote.
The chemistry of fermentation with yeasts, especially the science involved in beermaking and winemaking; zymurgy.
A treatise on the use of fermentation to produce liquors.
Any of various insects of the order Zygoptera; damselfly.
Of or pertaining to moths in the family Zygaenidae.
The study of beer and beer-brewing.
The hatred or fear of beer.
